methods.raw: Each admitted body source position; no deduplication or cross-unit concatenation added.
methods.teacher: Unique (record, source_token_position) in actual579-update schedule; seq[:-1] inputs, seq[1:] teachers; rightPAD input0 / ignore labels-100 excluded.
methods.visible: Separate source-context and actual row-visible LF run; row truncation can hide an LF without changing the gold token.
methods.exact1: Exactly one immediately preceding LF: includes the second LF teacher of a two-LF separator.
methods.exact2: Exactly two immediately preceding LF; no semantic paragraph classifier.
methods.middle: Not unit start, immediate LF, or literal sentence punctuation; not a linguistic clause tag.
methods.unit_start: Start of extracted unit, not necessarily true whole-document start. BOS-certified source-unit starts and fragments reported separately.
methods.literal: Nonoverlapping UTF8 substringまた, includingまたは/たまたま etc.; no conjunction POS claim. Teacher substring counted only if every covering BPE token is an actual target.
methods.realpersona: Split original token runs at special roles/EOS and match each original utterance; NEVER use synthetic LF joins from display text.
methods.references: Historical TRAIN raw source positions only, not equal exposure in B579. STAIR pool and actualA-used subset shown separately.

limitations: One source family for B; source-page and heading counts are not independent-author families.
Literal line/paragraph markers do not certify semantic starts. Whole-whitepaper document starts are not identified.
Historical source positions can include naturally repeated wording; no new independent-data claim.
